title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF TAYABAS TO MAKE A LOAN FROM PROVINCIAL FUNDS TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF LUCENA IN THAT PROVINCE.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF TAYABAS TO MAKE A LOAN FROM PROVINCIAL FUNDS TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF LUCENA IN THAT PROVINCE.
title.vi: Đạo luật ủy quyền Hội đồng Tỉnh Tayabas cho vay từ quỹ tỉnh để hỗ trợ Thị xã Lucena trong tỉnh này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้อำนาจสภาจังหวัดตัยยาบาสให้กู้ยืมเงินจากกองทุนจังหวัดเพื่อสนับสนุนเทศบาลลูเซนาในจังหวัดนั้น
title.id: Undang-Undang memberi wewenang Dewan Provinsi Tayabas untuk memberikan pinjaman dari dana provinsi kepada Kotamadya Lucena di provinsi tersebut
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa Majlis Wilayah Tayabas untuk membuat pinjaman daripada dana wilayah kepada Perbandaran Lucena di wilayah itu

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The provincial board of Tayabas is hereby authorized to loan from provincial funds the sum of six
thousand pesos, Philippines currency, to the municipality of Lucena, in the Province of Tayabas, such loan to
be used for the purpose of constructing a public school in the municipality of Lucena, and to be repaid to the
provincial treasury on or before one year from the date of the loan without interest.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 3, 1903.
